ops.text: Mitigation test in flight: launchctl disable + bootout of system/com.apple.audio.coreaudiod and system/com.apple.audiomxd in the live guest at epoch 1786594799 (both confirmed gone; only their idle distnoted agents remain). launchd baseline CPU time at bootout: 19392:31.20 — i.e. 323 CPU-hours since boot, 0.72 cores average for launchd alone, confirming the chronic burn. Measuring launchd CPU delta over the next ~70s, then BlueBubbles health check. Note launchctl disable persists across reboots (written to disabled.plist) — matches what codifying in debloat.bluebubbles would do anyway.
